title: Definately pungent when unlite!
text: Definately pungent when unlite!. I was very concerned with the very strong scent coming out of the unopened delivery box!  Definately agree with another writer that the raw inscence is very pungent, but after the first 10 seconds of being lite, the much more pleasant fragrance comes through,  very mellow, which I like to use in the latter half of e day.  More of energy cleansing than for meditation.  Not one of my favorites, but everyone to their own preference.  But great value.

product_metadata.title: Song of India India Temple Incense 120 Stick Large Box (3)
description: Song of India - India Temple Incense Sticks. 120 sticks per package (150 grams). The original, light, fresh scent of holy temples in India. Aroma is designed to smell just like a temple in India. Using only the finest herbs, spices, fragrant wood powders, essential perfume oils and resins to create this heavenly scent. A very fine fragrance that matches and blends into the human sense of scents. A portion of the proceeds from the sale of this product goes toward the Song of India Association that helps needy children of India.
